summary: 11 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • dungeon: add DescriptionKey to hero dungeon catalog entries (52fb058)
  • retry: add HTTP 429 rate limit to retryable terminal failures (9eb8d09)
  • frontend-config: add AI commit default behavior setting (c457d0a)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: propagate profession metadata through session and mobile hero flows (751c774)
  • statusbar: add session concurrency indicator and achievement drawer improvements (731e7c7)
  • proposals: sync AI language before proposal generation and execution (aca0576)
  • ai: add language sync helper for proposal action preflight (c68df75)
  • indexGenerator: add product splash loading screen (1e854a3)
  • settings: add AI commit default behavior radio group (fca065a)
  • git: enhance AI commit flow with improved logging and gate handling (2dad190)
  • git: add AI commit split button and default behavior setting (5e1f235)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • mono-specs: add fallback for repository URL assignment (58948c3)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: preserve trailing content in compact profession badges with RTL layout (f5e18e7)
